title: L1·분광 손실 C2MS에 관측 일치 사영 결합의 정식 판정과 사영 가속
hypothesis: 65 C2MS_L1S with the 45/66 observation-consistency projection at inference beats the same-seed C2MS on RR on every training sensor (QB, GF2, WV3), and a cheaper projection (float32 or an early-stopped conjugate gradient) keeps that result at a fraction of the projection time.
prior_observation: 66 (post-hoc analysis, judged 'not a performance comparison') and the reference comparisons fixed in 79/80 already measured 65 + P against C2MS on these test sets: QB +0.072 dB / -0.102 deg / -0.027, GF2 +0.191 / -0.028 / -0.017, WV3 +0.130 / -0.091 / -0.017 (3 seeds each), WV2 transfer +0.171 / -0.348 / -0.087. 66 recommended a new experiment with the inference and the control fixed in advance; this is that experiment. The test numbers of the official candidate are therefore not new; the registration fixes the candidate, control and judgement before this run, and the projection variants and their GPU time are new.
candidate: C2MS_L1S + P: the archived 65 C2MS_L1S weights (no retraining) with 79 prepare.Projected after every inference (float64, interior margin 5, conjugate gradient per band, tolerance 1e-8, at most 400 iterations), using the Wald operator of the test sensor

P32.note: network output, MS and FFT operator in float32

variant_keep_rule.rule: fixed before evaluation: a variant keeps the projection when, on every judged sensor and every seed, its RR PSNR is within 0.005 dB of C2MS_L1S + P and its 3-seed v2.4 label against C2MS equals the official one; reported per sensor, not a separate judgement

comparisons.official: per training sensor (QB, GF2, WV3): C2MS_L1S + P vs plain C2MS of the same seed, 3-seed mean (criteria v2.4, RR only, threshold 0.04 dB)
comparisons.decomposition: C2MS_L1S + P vs C2MS + P (the loss's share with the projection on both), C2MS + P vs C2MS (the projection alone), C2MS_L1S vs C2MS (the loss alone, 65)
comparisons.variants: each variant vs C2MS (v2.4) and vs C2MS_L1S + P (difference)
comparisons.reference: WV2 transfer (WV3-trained models, all comparisons, reference only); FR QNR/D_lambda/D_s; C2MS_L1S vs the original C0
comparisons.baseline: replacing the C2MS baseline needs a 3-seed improvement (AGENTS.md); this experiment does not replace it automatically, it reports whether the condition is met

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained models on the WV2 test set; reference only

metrics: RR (PSNR, SAM, ERGAS, SCC, Q2n) and FR (QNR, D_lambda, D_s, observation RMSE) from the 54 scene metrics; RR2 and FR_WALD are not computed (not in v2.4)
scenes_note: QB fixed scenes; the same indices on GF2, WV3 and WV2 (as 65 stage 3 and 80); chosen before evaluation
expected_duration: about 1 h on the GPU (9 sensor-seed evaluations, WV3 also on WV2; no training)
limits: the official candidate's test numbers were already measured in 66/79/80 (see prior_observation)
the projection adds an iterative step at inference; GPU time is reported for every variant
65 C2MS_L1S was trained with the spectral weight calibrated on QB (0.46) on every sensor
